UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Personal academic planner profile and sample plan seed marker for an authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name of the student, lecturer, or programme coordinator.

seededSamplePlan.description: Whether initial sample academic deadlines have been seeded for this user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AssessmentDeadline.title: AssessmentDeadline
AssessmentDeadline.description: An academic assessment deadline (assignment, test, presentation, or examination) in a user's personal plan.

title.description: Title of the assignment, test, presentation, or examination.

courseCode.description: Course code such as CS301 or MATH204.

dueDateEpochDay.description: UTC epoch day representing the assessment due date.

dueTimeLabel.description: Formatted 24h due time label such as 23:59 or 14:00.

weightPercent.description: Percentage weighting toward final course grade (0-100).

roleContext.description: Academic role context for the deadline item.

notes.description: Optional submission guidelines, room number, or preparation notes.

isSampleSeed.description: Indicates whether this item originated from the sample plan.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and planner role preferences scoped by authenticated UID.

/users/{userId}/assessments/{assessmentI.description: User-owned academic deadlines and assessments in their personal planner.
